fieldValues.title: Metamodel generator has no per-field version override — exclude the metamodel package from the versioning cell instead
fieldValues.summary: check-versioning-cell.mjs's one known corpus violation (value_range.json's allowedValues changed with no version bump) is ruled out of scope entirely rather than fixed: the metamodel package is a frozen, hand-verified bootstrap fixed point nothing resolves by namespace/name@version.
fieldValues.body:
PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/781 (open, gate:owner-merge — worker opened it and did not arm auto-merge, per the owner's own classification in the issue's dispatch comment). Mode: complicated · Cell: versioning · Door: 2 (new normative meaning — scopes what the versioning-cell rule covers).

What landed: `scripts/check-versioning-cell.mjs`'s `EXCLUDED` list gained `srs/package/metamodel`, alongside the existing `rfcs/rfc-004` exclusion; a new `rfc-decision` record (`rfc-decision-991c062f`) makes the ruling explicit; the now-inapplicable `versioning-cell-allowlist.json` entry was removed rather than kept; `docs/spec/rfcs/rfc-decision-log.md` was re-rendered with the pinned CLI; and a new guard-bite case in `tests/guards/run.mjs` proves the exclusion actually narrows the walk (verified red without the exclusion, green with it).

Both `validate-all.mjs` and `check-release-drift.mjs` pass by exit code on the final diff. Real red was hit and fixed along the way: `check-release-drift.mjs` first failed on rendered-doc drift (`docs/spec/rfcs/rfc-decision-log.md` stale) until `publish-spec.mjs` was re-run with the pinned CLI after authoring the decision record — any unit that authors a new `rfc-decision` (or otherwise touches `srs/records/`) needs a re-render pass before that gate goes green, not just before opening the PR.

Also confirmed the shallow-clone trap (CLAUDE.md) is not hypothetical: this session's checkout was shallow at start (`git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` → true) and was unshallowed before running any git-history-dependent check, including this very check-versioning-cell.mjs (a structural diff over git history).

Scope discipline held: did not touch `scripts/gen-metamodel-package.mjs`, the `FIELD_SPECS` table, or the RFC-033/RFC-035 closure tests, and did not advance any pin.
